name: Mistral Loom Service Promise
text:
Mistral Loom Service Promise
Mistral Loom supplies Archive Shuttle under the Lantern plan. These terms apply from 2034-01-01 through 2034-12-31.
The measurement period is a UTC calendar month. Monthly availability equals 100 multiplied by (1 minus unavailable minutes divided by all minutes in the month).
For each complete 0.2 percentage-point shortfall of monthly availability below 99.7%, the service credit is 6% of the affected monthly service fee in USD. Count only completed steps, discard any remaining fraction of a step, and cap the resulting credit at 30% of that fee.
Round only the final credit amount to the nearest cent, with half a cent rounded upward. The credit is applied against a future invoice.
Claims must be received within 17 calendar days following the end of the service month.
